name: FresherHub
author: FresherHub
description: Read-only job-readiness data for freshers in tech from FresherHub (https://fresherhub.app): 11 entry-level roles, the skills each role needs, the proof that counts for each skill, and a step-by-step readiness checklist. No auth, no user data.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.title: List fresher tech roles
tools.description: List the entry-level tech roles FresherHub checks job readiness for (Backend, Frontend, Data Analyst, AI Engineer and more), with a link to each role's requirements page.

tools.name: get_role_skills
tools.title: Get a role's required skills and proof
tools.description: Get the skills a fresher needs for one tech role: area, must-have flag, share of the readiness score, and the evidence (resume, GitHub, portfolio) that proves each skill.

role.description: Role slug from list_roles (for example "backend-developer") or the role name ("Backend Developer").

tools.name: get_readiness_checklist
tools.title: Get a fresher job-readiness checklist
tools.description: Get a step-by-step job-readiness checklist for one tech role: the stages in order, the skills in each stage and the concrete actions that build proof for them.

role.description: Role slug from list_roles (for example "backend-developer") or the role name ("Backend Developer").
